title: Inside a gene-building wet lab
subtitle: An example bench for assembling DNA fragments into a sequence-verified plasmid
scope: Illustrative laboratory layout. Numbers identify tool groups, not protocol steps. Brand examples are alternatives, not one installed system.

items.name: Synthetic DNA fragments / oligos
items.use: Supply designed DNA sequences for construct assembly.
items.examples: Twist Gene Fragments, GenScript, Tsingke Tsynth

items.name: Vector DNA
items.use: Provide the plasmid backbone that receives the insert.

groups.name: Reaction setup
groups.objects: Pipettes, tips, enzyme mix and tubes
groups.brands:
Pipettes: Gilson / Eppendorf
Assembly mix: NEB / Vazyme

items.name: Assembly mix / PCR mix
items.use: Join DNA fragments or amplify selected templates. These are distinct reagents and operations.
items.examples: NEB NEBuilder / Q5, Vazyme ClonExpress / Phanta

items.name: Pipette tips and microtubes
items.use: Carry liquids and hold samples. Choose fit and purity for the application.

items.name: Thermocycler
items.use: Control temperature during PCR and compatible assembly incubations. Some incubations can use a heating block.

items.name: PCR plates, tubes and sealing film
items.use: Contain reactions in an instrument-compatible format.

items.name: Microcentrifuge
items.use: Support sample separation and spin-column workflows.

items.name: DNA cleanup kit / plasmid miniprep kit
items.use: Purify PCR products or isolate plasmid DNA after clone growth. These are different kit applications.
items.examples: QIAGEN QIAquick / QIAprep, TIANGEN purification / TIANprep

items.name: Fluorometer and DNA assay kit
items.use: Estimate DNA concentration with an appropriate fluorescent assay and standards.

items.name: Gel electrophoresis / imaging system
items.use: Visualize DNA fragment-size patterns. This does not read the base sequence.

items.name: Agarose, ladder, dye and assay tubes
items.use: Support size and concentration QC. Fluorometry requires compatible assay tubes and standards.

groups.name: Clone growth
groups.brands:
Shaker: Eppendorf
Cells / media: NEB / Thermo Fisher

items.name: Shaking incubator
items.use: Support growth of a suitable laboratory host culture. The illustrated unit is generic.

items.name: Cloning cells and growth medium
items.use: Host and expand plasmid constructs. Transformation and colony selection precede liquid clone expansion.
items.examples: NEB cloning cells, Thermo Fisher media

items.name: Culture tubes, flasks and plates
items.use: Hold cultures during clone selection and expansion.

groups.name: Sequence confirmation
groups.brands:
Service: Tsingke / GenScript
Instrument: Applied Biosystems

items.name: Sanger service / sequencer
items.use: Read sequence data and compare the construct with the design. An analysis screen does not imply an on-site sequencer.
items.examples: Tsingke / GenScript service, Applied Biosystems SeqStudio

items.name: Sequence trace and construct record
items.use: Link sequence identity with the sample record before expression or assays.
items.examples: Analysis software and laboratory sample records
